sourceContradictions: p1 K3 numerical lmin denominator prints1−0.2 although eta=0.8 and the preceding analytical expression uses1−eta; printed8.5cm is retained. K candle equation numbering skips5. Wire uses S both for section and surface; literal source notation retained.

p2 K6 negative-side equation1* prints x(t1)=−c(t0−t1). K7/K8 text prints tau=t1=t0 despite distinct signal times in the general model. K11 tau_min=−c²/(2a)+c/a=−c/(2a) has a dimension and arithmetic discrepancy; second factored image expression2.9 is also dimensionally inconsistent. Figure1.9/1.11/1.12 references and all superluminal multiple-image branches are literal native content.
p3 question hot inlet pressure p2 is labelled pB although B is the shared outlet junction and later source equations use hot inlet C. All rounding and backflow conditions retained.

p4 printed pulley key figure has an intrinsic caption/layout overlap at its lower border. Native circuit self-similarity transforms, alternate chain model and all root choices retained without drawing repair.

p5 K20 says push-off lasts more than an oscillation period by a factor10 although source t1≈0.1s and period1s; x20 instead of prior x1 is literal. Footnote marker6 at K21 has no footnote6 text anywhere in the complete packet. K24 h→−h instruction coexists with unchanged1+(1−h/L)² denominator; displayed numerical recurrence differs from Q h/L=0.10. Key gives final angular speed rather than a separate explicit Deltaomega result; no additional result invented.

p6 Q atomic chlorine mass35 differs from K35.5. K26 chloride/positive-charge wording conflicts with the alternating charge model. K27 repeated equation tags13/14/15 retained; ion-count label uses a formula-unit mass58.5. Supplement self-energy q²/(8piepsilon0r) corresponds to a charged shell although source calls uniformly charged sphere. Native model and dissolution estimate retained.

p7 Q magnetic constant prints mu0=1.26 H/m without10^-6. K30 density-ratio numerical line drops the different10^-8/10^-7 factors yet reports2cm. K29 repeats equation4; K32 references figure6 while displayed coordinates figure is4; K34 polarization text saysfigure2 besidefigure1, and K35 cites expressions2/6. All literal source cross-references and complete Lorentz-Lorenz supplement retained.

p8 K39 and K41 print omega0≈3pi h/v0, opposite dimensional quotient to phi=omega h/v0; K41 therefore prints omega0 proportional sqrt(m). K39 tau0≈2pi n lacks a frequency divisor. K40 cosine addition expression41 has a minus where the subsequent exact-phase form has plus. All stated approximations, exact-extremum derivation and four original3D graph views retained literally.

p9 K45 equation8 prints N0=N−N0 rather than N−N1; intermediate outgoing-intensity expression lacks Deltax that reappears in transmittance10. K46/47 equations13/17 retain A Deltat after other time factors are cancelled, whereas18 onward uses A. All threshold/output expressions and diagrams are native and no source solution silently corrected.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Титульные листы и общие инструкции
sourceCaveatNotes.statement:
УТВЕРЖДЕНО. Заместитель председателя оргкомитета заключительного этапа Республиканской олимпиады. К.С. Фарино. «___» марта 2006 г.

Республиканская физическая олимпиада 2006 год. г. Гродно. Теоретический тур. 9 класс / 10 класс / 11 класс.

Оргкомитет и Жюри заключительного этапа Республиканской олимпиады школьников 2006 года
- приветствуют вас в городе Гродно;
- поздравляют с успешным выступлением на предыдущих этапах олимпиады;
- желают успехов на заключительном этапе.

1. Полный комплект состоит из трех не связанных между собой заданий.
2. При оформлении работы каждую задачу начинайте с новой страницы. Первая половина тетради предназначена для чистовика, вторая - черновика. При недостатке бумаги обращайтесь к оргкомитету, обеспечим!
3. Подписывать тетради и отдельные страницы запрещается.
4. В ходе работы можете использовать ручки, карандаши, чертежные принадлежности, калькулятор.
5. Со всеми вопросами, связанными с условиями задач (но не с их решениями), обращайтесь к представителям Жюри.
